_comment: Reviews left on CapRock's Google Business Profile, copied here word
for word. This file is the only place they are written down;
tools/build-reviews.js puts them into the pages.
RULES, and they matter more than the copy:
1. Never write a review nobody left. These are real people and the
text is theirs. Copy it exactly, including the odd phrasing.
2. Only reviews that were shown in full. Google truncates long ones
behind 'View full review'; four of the nine were truncated on 30
September and are left out rather than guessed at.
3. These do NOT go into the structured data as an aggregateRating.
Google disallows self-serving reviews, meaning reviews about a
business published on that business's own site, and would ignore
or penalise them. They count where they already are, on the
Business Profile. Here they are for the answer engines, which
read this site and not our Google listing.
4. profileUrl is the public Google reviews link. Until it is set,
the 'read them all' line does not render, because a dead link is
